anti_gaming_invariants: patient outcomes cannot be supplied as action fields
the rescue vessel endpoint vertices are attached to authored world fixtures
physics steps and simulation time must increase monotonically per observed target and per pump channel
instantaneous ventilation and active repair effects expire when their scene evidence is not refreshed in the current physics interval
unilateral contact cannot create bilateral compression
contact outside the authored target neighborhood cannot control the defect
vessel upstream pressure is coupled to shared patient MAP and inconsistent pressure evidence is rejected
clip occlusion requires a retained scene attachment
patch sealing requires distributed contact points and dwell
film sealing requires retained perimeter bonds distributed contact measured cavity pressure and a continuous hold window
pump delivery requires mutually consistent plunger displacement outlet flow and reservoir mass loss
pump delivery reaches the patient only through a retained vascular attachment and valid line pressure
ventilation support requires an attached airway valid pressure circuit flow and measured chest excursion
hemostasis success requires a continuous measured upstream-pressure challenge window and cannot be activated by action intent
hemostasis success also requires preserved distal perfusion
reward is computed from patient state change including blood loss distal perfusion MAP oxygenation and new damage rather than action identity
a favorable steady state earns no repeated reward
